description: Evaluation of the hydraulic performance of an urban stormwater drainage system is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors José Anderson Do Nascimento Batista, Andressa Juliana Boldrin. ABSTRACT The lack of effective planning and integration between the urban infrastructure administrations associated with the widespread soil development provokes surcharge over the storm sewer pipe network. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
